# Decision Log

**Use it when:** always. Start it on day one of an engagement.
**It exists to stop:** re-litigating a settled call six weeks later with nobody
remembering why.

This is the shape the game exports (⚙️ Settings → Export → 📄 Decision report). One
entry per real call. A decision that took a minute still gets a line.
